title: Investigate
subtitle: 「調查／查究／研究」，要先分清是在仔細審視證據、開放式探討問題、正式查案、實體檢查，還是以數據分析來找原因。
description: 「調查／查究／研究」，要先分清是在仔細審視證據、開放式探討問題、正式查案、實體檢查，還是以數據分析來找原因。

words.example: The committee examined the evidence before reaching a conclusion.
words.exampleZh: 委員會在作出結論前仔細審視證據。

exercises.original: The committee investigated the evidence before reaching a conclusion.
exercises.zh: 委員會在作出結論前仔細審視證據。
exercises.upgrade: The committee examined the evidence before reaching a conclusion.

options.explanation: evidence being looked at carefully before a conclusion is reached fits examine。
searched would mean trying to locate something。
accused changes from fact-finding to blaming someone。
interrogated applies to questioning people。
checked briefly is too shallow for careful evidence review。
researched generally is broader and less specific to the evidence in hand.

exercises.original: Doctors investigated the scan carefully for signs of internal injury.
exercises.zh: 醫生仔細檢查掃描影像是否有內傷跡象。
exercises.upgrade: Doctors examined the scan carefully for signs of internal injury.

options.explanation: careful inspection of a scan is naturally examine。
searched/looked up imply locating information rather than studying an image。
interrogated applies to people。
accused is unrelated。
researched is too broad for one scan.
本題教材沒有為此選項提供個別解釋。

exercises.original: The review investigates whether the evidence supports the claim.
exercises.zh: 這項檢討審視證據是否支持該主張。
exercises.upgrade: The review examines whether the evidence supports the claim.

options.explanation: a review assessing evidence and a claim fits examine。
accuses implies blame。
searches means looks for something。
interrogates applies to questioning。
checks out informally is too casual。
inspects physically is the wrong kind of scrutiny.

words.example: The study explores why some students leave school early.
words.exampleZh: 研究探討為何部分學生提早離校。

exercises.original: The study investigates why some students leave school early.
exercises.zh: 研究探討為何部分學生提早離校。
exercises.upgrade: The study explores why some students leave school early.

options.explanation: an open-ended academic question about causes is naturally explored。
accuses/interrogates imply wrongdoing or forceful questioning。
inspects is physical。
searches for suggests locating something。
checks briefly is too shallow.
本題教材沒有為此選項提供個別解釋。

exercises.original: The workshop investigates several possible solutions to the problem.
exercises.zh: 工作坊探討這個問題的數個可能解決方案。
exercises.upgrade: The workshop explores several possible solutions to the problem.

options.explanation: considering multiple possibilities is a classic explore context。
inspect is physical/compliance-focused。
accuse/interrogate are unrelated。
check is too narrow。
search suggests locating rather than considering alternatives.
本題教材沒有為此選項提供個別解釋。

exercises.original: The report investigates how technology might change future work.
exercises.zh: 報告探討科技可能如何改變未來工作。
exercises.upgrade: The report explores how technology might change future work.

options.explanation: future possibilities and implications call for explore。
interrogate/accuse imply people or wrongdoing。
inspect is physical。
check briefly is too shallow。
search is about locating information.
本題教材沒有為此選項提供個別解釋。

words.example: The manager promised to look into the complaint.
words.exampleZh: 經理承諾調查這宗投訴。

exercises.original: The manager promised to investigate the complaint.
exercises.zh: 經理承諾調查這宗投訴。
exercises.upgrade: The manager promised to look into the complaint.

options.explanation: a routine complaint being investigated fits the conversational phrasal verb look into。
search for means locate rather than investigate。
accuse jumps to blame。
interrogate is much stronger and person-focused。
inspect physically is the wrong mode。
study academically is too formal and research-oriented.

exercises.original: The airline is investigating why the baggage was delayed.
exercises.zh: 航空公司正在調查行李延誤原因。
exercises.upgrade: The airline is looking into why the baggage was delayed.

options.explanation: service problem + cause-finding is a natural look-into context。
accusing/interrogating imply wrongdoing or questioning。
searching for is incomplete unless something is missing。
inspecting is physical。
researching academically is too formal.
本題教材沒有為此選項提供個別解釋。

exercises.original: We'll investigate the billing error and reply tomorrow.
exercises.zh: 我們會調查帳單錯誤，明天回覆。
exercises.upgrade: We'll look into the billing error and reply tomorrow.

options.explanation: customer-service follow-up on an error is idiomatic look into。
accuse/interrogate are inappropriate。
search for suggests locating the error but not necessarily understanding it。
inspect is physical/compliance-oriented。
research is too academic.
本題教材沒有為此選項提供個別解釋。

words.example: A panel was appointed to inquire into the incident.
words.exampleZh: 當局委任小組調查該事件。

exercises.original: A panel was appointed to investigate the incident.
exercises.zh: 當局委任小組調查該事件。
exercises.upgrade: A panel was appointed to inquire into the incident.

options.explanation: appointed panel + incident indicates a formal inquiry。
check out casually is too informal。
search for means locate。
inspect physically is narrower。
accuse presumes blame。
interrogate only is merely one possible method.

exercises.zh: 委員會將調查失當行為指控。

search and inspect are narrower actions。
accuse is not fact-finding。

exercises.original: Parliament set up a committee to investigate the failure.

search for and inspect are limited methods。
accuse/interrogate do not express the whole investigation.

falseSynonyms.zh: 搜尋不等於 investigate search 通常是尋找某人、某物或資料；investigate 是查明原因、事實或責任。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Searching may be one step in an investigation.

falseSynonyms.zh: 檢查不等於完整調查 check 往往只是確認狀態或正確性；investigate 通常更深入。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON A check is often narrower and quicker.

falseSynonyms.zh: research 只在系統研究 sense 接近 investigate 學術研究和事件調查目的不同。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Research builds knowledge; investigation often establishes what happened.

falseSynonyms.zh: inspect 只在實體檢查 sense 接近 investigate inspect 常檢查物件、場所或設備狀況。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Inspection is physical or compliance-focused.

falseSynonyms.zh: 分析不等於完整 investigate analyse 是研究資料的方法之一，但調查還可能包括訪問、搜證、查紀錄等。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Analysis is one investigative method.

falseSynonyms.zh: 指控不等於調查 accuse 是聲稱某人做錯事；investigate 是查證是否真的發生。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Accusation is not investigation.

falseSynonyms.zh: 盤問不等於 investigate interrogate 是強力問話，可能是調查的一部分。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Interrogation is one possible investigative technique.

falseSynonyms.zh: 詞性陷阱 investigate 是動詞；investigation 是名詞。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Investigate is a verb; investigation is a noun.
